BiblicalUsage: Nachshon is the prince of Judah, the man who led his tribe out of Egypt and into the promised land. In Numbers 1:7 he is named as Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of Judah, and in Ruth 4:20 Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon, and in 1 Chronicles 2:10 Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a prince is measured by where he leads, and Nachshon led Judah first in the march and first in the line to David. He led Judah in the march, and the tribe followed him.
